_meta.method: playwright-cli (Chrome, live site https://aura-financial-paid.aura.build/, viewport 1440x900); canvas-element screenshots at 2 Hz; luminance via ffmpeg signalstats YAVG; animation audit via document.getAnimations() inside the about:srcdoc frame
_meta.why: The 2026-08-11 extraction ran against a locally-served copy on :8899 and probed the top document only, where raw/probes.json recorded canvas:0. The shader lives in the srcdoc iframe.

canvas.found_in: about:srcdoc iframe (NOT the top document — cause of the original canvas:0 miss)

shader_macro_cycle.description: Amorphous vortex/nebula that grows to fill the viewport, then recedes to a small dark lens shape. Not a clean loop — noise-driven, so it never repeats exactly.
shader_macro_cycle.observed_range_seconds: roughly 30-60s between full-bright and fully-receded states

shader_palette_observed.method: brightest 8% of pixels, quantised to a 24-step cube, from canvas screenshots
shader_palette_observed.note: The shader reads distinctly more teal/cyan than the CSS accent --color-accent #38BDF8. Any CSS substitute keyed only to #38BDF8 will look bluer than the original.

shader_authored_colours.note: #4C961D and #36B612 also appear as vec3 literals but are luma coefficient vectors (0.299,0.587,0.114 and 0.2126,0.7152,0.0722), not colours.

shader_layer_stack.role: shape 'Bram no blend' — main composite layer, 4 child effects
single '.' glyph, Inter 10px, blendMode OVERLAY, 2 replicate effects

mouse_reactivity.scene_evidence: trackMouse=0 and mouseMomentum=0 on all 14 layers

empirical_ab_test.method: canvas screenshots 2.85s apart (one pulse period); condition A mouse parked at (20,20), condition B mouse swept across the hero; compared within-condition consecutive diffs
empirical_ab_test.conclusion: Sweeping the cursor produces no more change than leaving it still — the field is free-running and cursor-independent.

scroll_reactivity.verdict: NONE for the shader itself; what varies with scroll is attenuation, not rendering
scroll_reactivity.canvas_wrapper: .aura-background-component — 'top-0 w-full h-screen -z-10 fixed', 900px tall, pinned to viewport rows 0-900

contribution_measurement.method: full-page screenshot at each scroll offset with canvas visibility visible vs hidden; YAVG of the difference blend (ffmpeg signalstats)
contribution_measurement.noise_floor_method: two captures 0.4s apart with the shader hidden in both — isolates CSS-animation drift
contribution_measurement.conclusion: The field is NOT hero-only. It contributes a faint 9-25% wash for the full page length, well above the 0.04 noise floor. A substitute that stops at the hero boundary will render the lower page flatter than the original.

scroll_reactivity.correction_note: An earlier draft of DESIGN.md 10a claimed the sections were opaque and the field contributed nothing below the hero. This measurement refutes that and the section was rewritten.

ambient_animation_audit.method: document.getAnimations() on the live page inside the about:srcdoc frame
ambient_animation_audit.verdict_on_R13: CONFIRMED — 42 infinite / 0 finite, exactly as claimed by the static CSS read
ambient_animation_audit.effect_level_easing: linear on all 42 (tokens.css --ease-* apply to transitions, not to these keyframes)
corrections_to_prior_table: pulse also runs at 1500ms (prior table listed 2s only)
beam also runs at 4000ms (prior table listed 3s only)
bounce durations are 1000ms and 4000ms (prior table listed '—')
counts per keyframe were never recorded before; beam and pulse dominate at 6 instances each

interaction_states.method: hover/group-hover utility census over raw/template-source.html + live getAnimations() probe
interaction_states.token_alignment: duration-300/500/700/1000 map exactly onto --duration-component/card/slow/image. No utility uses 150ms, so --duration-micro is not exercised by any hover utility.

marquee_pause_on_hover.evidence: getAnimations()[0] on the marquee track: playState running (t=370950ms) -> paused (t=371066ms) -> still paused (t=371066ms, frozen across 1.6s) -> running (t=372350ms) after mouse-out

shimmer_accelerates_on_hover.note: base shimmer is 4000ms; hovering re-declares it at 1.5s — a 2.7x speed-up

accordion.note: height-driven disclosure, no JS toggle needed
